# Best slim Qi2 / MagSafe power banks for iPhone 17

**My pick for most people: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)**
- It's 0.34" thick, weighs 4.3 oz, holds 5,000mAh, and charges at 15W Qi2. Anker lists the iPhone 17 series as compatible. [Anker product page](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)
- 9to5Mac calls it the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery. It also says the Anker is very thin, feels premium, and runs cooler than competitors. [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)
- It costs $54.99 right now, with an auto-applied $5 discount. **[Buy from Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)**

**Other good options**

| Need | Pick | Specs | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| Thinnest and lightest | Baseus Picogo Air AM71 | 0.27", 104g, 5,000mAh, but only 7.5W wireless | $52.99 on Amazon (list $69.99) |
| Slim with 25W and 10,000mAh | INIU SnapGo Air | 0.5", 195g, 25W Qi2.2, 45W wired, lanyard-style cable | $42.99 to $48.99 on Amazon |
| Slim with 15W | ReelCharge ReelSafe | 0.35", 119g, 5,000mAh, 15W, semi-solid-state | $49.99 |
| Rugged | TORRAS MiniMag Pro | 0.57", 195g, 10,000mAh, 15W, IP54 water and dust resistance | $69.99 to $79.99 |

Specs and prices are from [Android Central's roundup](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge). It didn't give direct product links, so you'll need to search those product names on Amazon.

**Things to know**
- The iPhone 17 supports Qi2.2 at 25W, so the 15W banks leave some speed unused. Macworld notes that only iPhone 16 and later can use 25W. [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)
- Macworld also says the INIU SnapGo Air is tied for the slimmest 10K MagSafe battery pack. If you want 25W without much bulk, that's the best fit.
- A 5,000mAh bank usually gives about 60–75% of a phone charge, while 10,000mAh gives close to two. Choose 5K for pocketability and 10K for longer days. [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)
- Thick or non-magnetic cases can weaken the connection. Anker says cases over 2.5 mm may interfere.
- I'd skip the Baseus PicoGo AM52 ($53.99 with code AM52) if slimness is your priority. It does 25W, but the listing gives no thickness or weight. [Dealectric listing, affiliate link](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w)
